newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorea Kia car units go limit-up on takeover news.
newsitem.headline: SKorea Kia car units go limit-up on takeover news.

text.p: Shares of Kia Motors and Asia Motors went limit-up in early trading on a news report that Hyundai Motor and unlisted Daewoo Motor had agreed to jointly take over Kia Motors, brokers said.
A Hyundai Motor spokesman denied the report.
Kia rose 1,000 won to its daily upper-limit of 14,000 and Asia gained 320 won to its limit of 4,320.
A third-party takeover is widely viewed as the best solution to Kia's problems.
"Such an agreement has not been made," said Lee Young-bok, a spokesman at Hyundai Motor.
South Korea's leading newspaper Chosun Ilbo said Hyundai and Daewoo had already discussed the joint merger and acquisition of Kia and agreed in principle to the deal.
